title: Conditional κ = 0.001679754788150048 from fine source-prime padding
body:
This raises the conditional final saving to **κ = 0.001679754788150048**, exceeding PR1758 head `8d975b6caba8d261f1924e527225c193219a9967` by more than 9.2793e-9. The new mechanism is fine source-prime padding; the signed-554 T74 finite supplier from PR1699 is unchanged.

Choose source primes at relative gap Θ(p^-2) from their dyadic targets. [Trudgian’s established prime theorem, Theorem 2](https://arxiv.org/html/1401.2689v2#S2) supplies enough distinct primes eventually. The smaller phase increment changes the grouped chirp guard to `beta + 2 xi - 2 < 1`. Absolute weight setup increases to `Cp + 64p² ceil(log₂ p)` bits, polynomially generated and amortized per complete microbox; online records remain O(p) bits. The proof charges a larger polynomial halo/core, dyadic normalizers once per group, and the existing explicit Strassen boundary (`7^16 < 2^45`). It does not rely on the structured boundary solver of PR1758. The parameter point is epsilon=0.9999999, beta=0.9999997, xi≈0.90792965478815.

The full dependency and precision argument is in [FINE-PRIME-PADDING.md](https://github.com/chafreaky/integer-mult-bounds/blob/c52345caa318fc6b1b6e2659c57d746317a72823/research/fine-prime-padding/FINE-PRIME-PADDING.md). The unchanged supplier has 319680 whole-helper roles, 249 base / 417 extra calls, dimension 73, live width 66304, prefix 1441 charged at 2048 and row coefficient 19545 below 20161. Its certified complex endpoint remains `335950991225108904267/200000000000000000000000`.

Validation:

- 56 exact strict inequalities, 14 rejecting variants and a separate derivation of all nine paid cost powers pass. Finite controls include 30 deterministic prime witnesses and a concrete underflow failure for the old absolute weight precision.
- Byte-preserved predecessor checks run with a corrected full symbolic-constant assertion, asserted circuit residuals, strict union-array equality and 64 additional fine-theta symbol samples. These are finite evidence, not an all-size proof.
- Full read-only-source replays passed on macOS/Python 3.11 (568.86 s) and Linux/Python 3.14 (642.21 s), including all 18 supplier-admission stages and seven composition stages. Complete `MATH.json` receipts are byte-identical: SHA256 `91553c2ce172165ecce79325eac0c71798fd3939f67236ec45f85c4d8870786b`. Manifest SHA256 `5399cb7adb01434dd53a22a5aaa3acd98e02902c232de4871421fe13c0b86559`. Every committed package file matches the frozen source. The default verifier has no native-reuse flag. Dedicated hosted CI is pending; this PR remains a draft until both Python jobs pass and their mathematical receipts match.

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/fine-prime-padding/requirements.txt
CXX=c++ BOOST_INCLUDE=/path/to/boost/include python3 -B \
  research/fine-prime-padding/verify.py --work /absolute/new-work
```

The multiplication conclusion retains the inherited all-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source, hosting, semantic online precision C1=1, fixed-tape/prime-packing, interchange, recovery and analytic assumptions. The new written prime/precision/locality transfer requires review; no unconditional theorem, practical cutoff or independent human review is claimed. The selected result is unchanged.

Credit Tim Trudgian for the cited prime theorem; Vlado Vojdanovski for PR1673; IdeaOuter and the PR1758 contributors for fractional-shift interiors and per-visit accounting; Jeremy Kothe and contributors for the radix-union lineage; LeverRank for the second simulation; and all supplier authors retained in PR1699’s notices. PR1672 has priority for the signed-554 kernel. This branch contains PR1699’s unchanged supplier package as a pinned dependency. New work is the fine-prime-padding package, its workflow and the byte-preservation attribute rule.

Prepared by Chafik Boukhalfa with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; original notices and source pins remain intact.
